note: Figure 5(b), FeTe0.65Se0.35, H // c-axis. The panel holds TEN isotherms: five for sample A (black open symbols) and five for sample B (red filled symbols), and temperature is carried by marker SHAPE, not by colour, so the colour-keyed digitiser cannot separate the five isotherms of a sample on colour alone. Each series here is therefore confined to its own curve by a staircase of per-series exclusion boxes, whose boundaries are the midlines between neighbouring same-colour curves measured from the crop. Only sample A's 7 K and 8 K curves are separable this way; A's 9, 10 and 11 K curves overlap each other and the frame ticks in the lower half of the panel and are not extracted. The x axis is in Oe (0 to 70000); first_major and last_major are given in TESLA (10 kOe = 1 T) so the output is in tesla. The x majors at 0 and 70000 Oe sit on the frame corners and are not walked, so the detected majors run 10000 to 60000 Oe, i.e. 1 to 6 T. There is no text layer on this page, so every annotation - legend, panel label, H//c-axis, the two sample labels and their arrows - is excluded by an explicit box.
